post.summary: Resolve and diagnose a draft layout
post.description: Resolves every element property of an unsaved draft layout and reports what is structurally broken or still unresolved, without persisting. Returns the per-element `resolutions` plus a well-formedness / resolvability `diagnostics` report. The optional `rootSource` resolves the draft against that source's context so resolvability can be checked. If neither `rootSource` nor `runtimeContext.entityType` supplies a source, intrinsic well-formedness and inline tokens requiring a source are checked; whole-field mappings and other binding checks remain unjudged. Optional `runtimeContext` hydrates the supplied entity using the Storefront rendering pipeline and adds runtime mapping findings, while keeping them out of preview and Storefront output. Its `entityType` supplies the root source and must match `rootSource` if both are supplied. A non-empty unknown `rootSource` is rejected with `400` (`unknownRootSource`). Unknown request fields are rejected with `400` (`unknownRequestField`). The whole request body is optional; an absent body diagnoses an empty tree. Requires the `content_layout:read` privilege. A malformed element config is reported as an `invalid_config` violation in the body at `200`, not as an error; a structurally malformed element is rejected with `400`.

boundToEntity.summary: Diagnose a draft against a product root source

intrinsicOnly.summary: Diagnose a draft without a bound source

200.description: The per-element resolutions plus the well-formedness / resolvability report. Never persisted, never cached.
